blocks.content:
This milestone needs [Grafana Assistant](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/get-started/) enabled, or otherwise the [LLM plugin](https://grafana.com/grafana/plugins/grafana-llm-app/) (`grafana-llm-app`) installed and enabled. If neither is available, you can finish the journey without this step.

You can ask AI to explain flame graphs.

On a regular **Flame graph**, look for **Analyze with Assistant** or **Explain Flame Graph**. Here on Diff, use **Analyze with Assistant** or **Explain Diff Flame Graph**.

To analyze with AI, complete the following steps:

blocks.description: Use Analyze with Assistant when Assistant is enabled; otherwise fall back to the LLM plugin.

whenFalse.description: Use Explain Diff Flame Graph when the LLM plugin is enabled on the Diff flame graph view.

whenFalse.content: Neither Grafana Assistant nor the LLM plugin (`grafana-llm-app`) is enabled on this stack, so you can finish without this step. To use flame graph AI later, [get started with Grafana Assistant](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/get-started/) or install and enable the [LLM plugin](https://grafana.com/grafana/plugins/grafana-llm-app/).
